faq_heading: Homes near Clayton Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Clayton Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Clayton Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Clayton Heights Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Clayton Heights Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 553 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,299,900, townhomes $746,000, condos $463,800. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Clayton Heights Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Clayton Heights Secondary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 553 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Clayton Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Hazelgrove Elementary (0.6 km east), Regent Road Elementary (0.9 km north) and Ecole Salish Secondary (1.0 km north-west).

Clayton Heights Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7003 188 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Clayton Heights Secondary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Clayton Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Clayton Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Clayton Heights Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 553 homes sold within 2 km of Clayton Heights Secondary: 208 houses, 257 townhomes and 79 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $746,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Clayton Heights Secondary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Clayton Heights Secondary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Hazelgrove Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Ecole Salish Secondary (1.0 km north-west), Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary (2.3 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Ecole Salish Secondary, 1.0 km north-west of Clayton Heights Secondary.
